task.title: Testing the SSL/TLS configuration using the CLI
task.shortdesc: To test your SSL/TLS configuration from the CLI, you can use podman login against your Red Hat Quay registry endpoint and review the certificate error for a self-signed authority. You can then log in with the --tls-verify=false option before configuring Podman to trust the certificate authority.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to attempt to log in to the Red Hat Quay registry with SSL/TLS enabled:

info.codeblock: Error: error authenticating creds for "quay-server.example.com": error pinging docker registry quay-server.example.com: Get "https://quay-server.example.com/v2/": x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
